record.title: CFTC swap data repository acceptance route
record.sub: Report trades and retain regulatory records
kv: Legal basis
CEA section 21 and 17 CFR Part 49; entity-specific CFTC repository status and service terms.
When it applies
A CFTC-regulated swap report must be accepted, maintained, and made available within the statutory SDR framework.
Named firms

Chicago Mercantile Exchange, Inc. (registered or chartered); DTCC Data Repository LLC · CFTC SDR (registered or chartered); ICE Trade Vault, LLC · CFTC SDR (registered or chartered); KOR Reporting Inc. · CFTC SDR (registered or chartered)
Who can use it
CFTC-registered or provisionally registered swap data repository within its approved scope
Conditions

Confirm the exact legal entity, CFTC status, asset-class scope, and current rules. Establish participant eligibility, repository selection, technical access, and successful data validation/acceptance. Keep repository maintenance separate from the counterparty or registered entity's reporting duty and correction duty.
The limit
Repository listing is not proof that a particular transaction is reportable, accepted, correctly reported, or within a named repository's service scope.
Evidence

Chicago Mercantile Exchange, Inc.: CFTC's list header reads 'Pending - Provisional Registration'; its remarks state that CME Inc. was provisionally registered on November 20, 2012 and identify interest-rate, credit, foreign-exchange, equity, and other-commodity asset classes.
Evidence

DTCC Data Repository LLC · CFTC SDR: CFTC's list header reads 'Pending - Provisional Registration'; its remarks state that DTCC Data Repository LLC was provisionally registered on September 19, 2012 for interest-rate, credit, equity, foreign-exchange, and other-commodity asset classes.
Evidence

ICE Trade Vault, LLC · CFTC SDR: CFTC's list header reads 'Pending - Provisional Registration'; its remarks state that ICE Trade Vault, LLC was provisionally registered on June 27, 2012 for other-commodity and credit asset classes.
Evidence
KOR Reporting Inc. · CFTC SDR: CFTC's list header reads 'Pending - Provisional Registration'; its remarks state that KOR Reporting Inc. was provisionally registered on March 30, 2022.
